text: 26F recurrent throbbing right-sided headache x6/12, about twice a month, lasts most of a day, with photophobia and nausea. No aura, no visual or sensory symptoms beforehand. Relieved by sleep in a dark room. Neuro exam normal, BP normal. Imp: migraine without aura. Plan: ibuprofen PRN, headache diary, lifestyle advice.

34M low mood and loss of interest in usual activities x2/12, with poor sleep, low energy, poor concentration and feelings of worthlessness. No hallucinations or delusions. No prior episodes, no history of elevated mood. Work and relationships moderately affected but still coping. Imp: single episode depressive disorder, moderate, without psychotic symptoms.

4yo girl, ear pain and fever x2/7, tugging at the right ear, now with purulent discharge from the right ear since this morning. O/E: right tympanic membrane perforated with mucopurulent discharge in the canal. Imp: acute suppurative otitis media. Plan: oral amoxicillin, analgesia, review.

40M manual labourer, low back pain x3/52 after lifting a heavy sack. Pain localised to the lumbar region, no radiation to legs, no numbness or weakness, no bladder or bowel symptoms. No fever, no weight loss. SLR negative, neuro exam normal. Imp: non-specific low back pain. Plan: analgesia, stay active, physio advice.

28F fatigue and breathlessness on exertion x2/12, heavy menstrual periods for over a year. O/E: pallor of conjunctivae, no jaundice. Ix: Hb 8.2, low MCV, low ferritin. Imp: iron deficiency anaemia secondary to menorrhagia (chronic blood loss). Plan: oral iron, investigate menorrhagia.

19M, central abdominal pain migrating to the right iliac fossa over 24h, anorexia, nausea, low-grade fever. O/E: tenderness and guarding at McBurney point, rebound positive, no generalised peritonism. Imp: acute appendicitis. Plan: surgical referral, NBM, IV fluids.

Homme de 28 ans, fievre avec frissons depuis 3 jours, cephalees frontales, courbatures generalisees, pas de vomissements ni de convulsions. Temperature 38.9. Goutte epaisse: trophozoites de Plasmodium falciparum vus, faible densite. Diagnostic: paludisme a Plasmodium falciparum sans complication.

Femme asthmatique depuis l'enfance, se presente avec oppression thoracique et sifflements depuis hier soir, l'inhalateur de secours ne soulage plus. Saturation 94 pour cent, sibilants bilateraux a l'auscultation, debit de pointe 60 pour cent. Diagnostic: crise d'asthme moderee. Plan: nebulisation de salbutamol, prednisolone.

Femme de 24 ans, fievre persistante depuis 10 jours, traitee pour paludisme sans amelioration. Fievre en plateau, cephalees, gene abdominale, constipation. Langue saburrale, bradycardie relative. Hemoculture: Salmonella Typhi isolee. Diagnostic: fievre typhoide.

Mwanamke miaka 45, uchovu, kutovumilia baridi, kuongezeka uzito kilo tano, kufunga choo, na hedhi nzito kwa miezi sita. Ngozi kavu, uso umevimba, mapigo ya kifundo cha mguu yanarudi polepole. Hakuna upasuaji wa shingo. Uchunguzi: homoni ya tezi (TSH) iko juu. Uamuzi: upungufu wa homoni ya tezi (hypothyroidism).

Mwanaume miaka 60, kikohozi chenye makohozi ya kijani, homa, na kupumua kwa shida kwa siku tatu. Joto 38.8, mapigo ya moyo 104, kupumua 28. Sauti za crackles upande wa kulia wa kifua. Uamuzi: nimonia (pneumonia). Mpango: antibiotiki, oksijeni ikihitajika.

Mujer de 30 anos, cefalea pulsatil recurrente en el lado izquierdo, varias veces al mes, dura casi todo el dia, con fotofobia y nauseas. Sin aura, sin sintomas visuales previos. Mejora al dormir en una habitacion oscura. Examen neurologico normal. Diagnostico: migrana sin aura.
